raw_text: Tesseract portal confirmed above Stark Tower. Multiple bogies inbound. Activating Iron Legion. Arc reactor grid at full draw. Requesting all hands.
Chitauri ground units breaching the perimeter. Medical bay overwhelmed—requesting 200 additional medical kits from Wakanda reserves immediately.
We have Chitauri units in sector seven. Three civilians down. Clean water distribution points compromised. Air support needed over the compound.
Chitauri leviathan has cleared the outer wall. Arc reactor power cells depleting at triple the normal rate. Vibranium reinforcements holding the south corridor.
Portal energy readings detected from New Asgard. Dispatching Einherjar to the compound. Medical kit stockpiles packaged for emergency airlift.
Secondary Chitauri wave has entered Sokovia airspace. Civilians evacuating. Water treatment plant is offline. Requesting SHIELD support.
Energy output from the tesseract sceptre spike detected. Pym Particle containment units at Sanctum Sanctorum showing anomalous readings. Recommend isolation protocol.
EXO-7 wing damaged. Arc reactor cores at 18% capacity in the east block. Requesting emergency cores from the Stark warehouse. We will not hold without them.
Wakanda is dispatching 50 kg of vibranium plating to reinforce the compound perimeter. Border Tribe mobilised. Expect convoy arrival within the hour.
The Hulk is contained. Lab is intact but power is down to 8%. Arc reactor cores fully depleted in Block C. Other hulk out imminent if we lose containment.
Nuke disposal complete. Warhead was Chitauri. Arc reactor cells blown across the north quad—stock critical. Portal structure is weakening. Preparing to close it.
Asgardian medical convoy has arrived. 120 kits distributed to field stations. Bifrost stable. New Asgard reserves stretched but holding.
Portal closed. Iron Man mark XLVII offline—taking it in for repairs. Arc reactor cores still critical but the rate has dropped. Good job everyone.
Mystic barrier projected over the compound. Pym Particle readings normalising. Sorcerers on standby for clean-up. Recommend a full resource audit within 24 hours.
Perimeter secured. Medical stations processing final casualties. Clean water supply restored to the east wing. Compound functional but resources stretched thin.
Sokovia stabilised. Chitauri remnants neutralised. Water treatment back online—expect full restoration in 6 hours. Population returning to shelters.
Arc reactor emergency stock arrived from Stark Industries facility. 80 cores delivered. Full post-incident resource audit underway. Situation resolved.
